records.review_note: Ethereum contract deployment is fixed to 2024-07-07; first mint, approved access, and broad public availability remain unresolved.

Transfero states that BRZ launched in 2019, and a dated Transfero-owned publication linked the BRZ launch article by 2019-07-25. The original public issuance day and first deployment boundary remain unverified.
Version, epoch, and distribution boundaries conflict.
Deployment, epoch, and architecture boundaries conflict.

Berachain fixed its mainnet launch to 2025-02-06 and official HONEY documentation identifies the mainnet contracts. No HONEY-specific first mint, first redemption, or first public minting transaction was recovered, so the network launch is not coerced into the asset launch date.

Stable Universal announced on 2019-07-17 that it would launch HUSD. By 2019-10-18, HUSD-PAX conversion was operational on Huobi. Contract deployment, first issuance, and first public redemption within that interval remain unresolved.
May 5 introduction, May 25 deployment, June 5 LP rewards, and live operation by June 11 are fixed; the exact first Cauldron, first issuance, and public UI day remain unresolved.
Announcement, issuance, deployment, and availability differ.

May 28 contract verification, the May 29 mainnet-live candidate, and June 5 official production-security coverage are fixed; the original first-party launch statement, exact creation transaction, and first permissionless mint remain unresolved.
Announcement, issuance, deployment, and approved access differ.
USDe launch and staking activation differ.

BiLira's official help center states that TRYB was initially released on Ethereum in 2019. The original announcement, contract deployment, first issuance, and first public redemption day remain unrecovered.

January 28 deployments, March 25 introduction, and April 7 testing are fixed; a first-party retrospective establishes April 2025 only at month level, while first issuance and broader public availability remain unresolved.
Mento Dollar and earlier Celo-dollar history differ.

Anzen's official retrospective establishes that USDz launched in June 2024. Current documentation confirms permissionless pool access and approved direct minting, but no day-level launch statement or reviewed first-public-availability transaction was recovered.

Circle publishes 2023-05-01 as the fund inception date, while Hashnote documents the onchain USYC token structure and subscription process. Fund inception is not treated as proof of the first token mint or first public token availability.
Product announcement, first mint, HyperCore activation, HyperEVM linking, and migration boundaries remain unresolved.

AE Coin had final regulatory approval by December 2024, but its 2025-01-17 whitepaper still describes issuance in future and introductory-phase terms. Mbank now provides live buy, transfer, receive, hold, and sell access, and public payment acceptance was reported by May 2025. The first issuance and first customer availability day remain unresolved.
